reviewItem.question: Does "`service_name` label: Loki 3.0 will automatically assign a `service_name` label to all ingested logs by default" mean a change to protocol-behavior:loki|name=automatic-service-name-label-assignment (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: Loki 3.0 automatically assigns a service_name label to all ingested logs by default, derived from a configurable list of existing labels or set to unknown_service if none are found.
